mapper.sql: c.id AS check_id,c.policy_id,c.policy_row_version,c.policy_snapshot_hash,c.rule_release_id,c.rule_row_version, c.rule_snapshot_hash,c.rule_content_hash,c.check_type_code,c.suite_version,c.engine_version,c.result_hash,c.case_count, c.case_ids_json::text AS case_ids_json,c.requested_by,c.idempotency_key,c.request_hash,c.created_at, (p.policy_status_code='DRAFT' AND p.row_version=c.policy_row_version AND p.rule_release_id=c.rule_release_id AND r.row_version=c.rule_row_version AND r.release_status_code IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE')) AS is_current
FROM announcement_attachment_policy_checks c JOIN announcement_attachment_policies p ON p.id=c.policy_id JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_releases r ON r.id=c.rule_release_id
mapper.select: -- 목록과 같은 정책 범위를 집계한다. SELECT count(1) WHERE c.policy_id=#{policyId}
-- 같은 요청의 기존 이력을 조회한다. 현재성은 과거 응답을 복사하지 않고 재계산한다. SELECT WHERE c.idempotency_key=#{key}
-- 최종 저장 transaction에서만 같은 검증 요청을 직렬화한다. SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(CAST(#{key} AS text),73103))::text
mapper.insert: -- 서버가 직접 실행한 분류 정답 세트만 저장한다. 게시·QA 전체 성공 상태는 없다. INSERT INTO announcement_attachment_policy_checks(id,policy_id,policy_row_version,policy_snapshot_hash,rule_release_id,rule_row_version, rule_snapshot_hash,rule_content_hash,check_type_code,suite_version,engine_version,result_hash,case_count,case_ids_json, requested_by,idempotency_key,request_hash) VALUES (#{checkId},#{policyId},#{policyVersion},#{policySnapshotHash},#{ruleReleaseId},#{ruleVersion},#{ruleSnapshotHash},#{ruleContentHash}, 'CLASSIFICATION_GOLDEN',#{suiteVersion},#{engineVersion},#{resultHash},#{caseCount},CAST(#{caseIdsJson} AS jsonb),#{requestedBy},#{idempotencyKey},#{requestHash})
